app.tagline: Your PC as a home server

install.title: Install Jellyfin
install.intro: Konak sets up everything Jellyfin needs on this PC and makes it reachable from your phone and other devices at home.
install.running: Installing… you can keep using your PC.
install.admin_note: Windows will ask once for administrator permission.

network.public_title: This network is set to Public
network.public_body: Windows blocks devices at home from reaching this PC on Public networks. Switch it to Private if this is your home network.

steps.network: Make it reachable on your network

reboot.title: Restart needed
reboot.body: Windows needs a restart to finish installing WSL. Konak continues on its own after you sign in again.

done.title: Jellyfin is ready
done.body: Open this address from any device on your home network:
done.media: Put your videos in the Konak\Media folder in your user folder.
done.tray: Konak keeps running in the system tray when you close this window.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.uac_declined: Administrator permission was declined. Konak needs it once to set up WSL and the firewall.
errors.virtualization_off: Virtualization is turned off in this PC's firmware (BIOS/UEFI). Turn it on, then try again.
